class_id.description: The class's ID, or account:<id> for the shares of an account with no recorded class.

converts.description: True for a non-participating preference class that does better converting.

has_preference.description: Whether it has a liquidation preference.

multiple.description: The multiple of the money invested its preference pays first.

participating.description: Whether it shares the rest as converted after its preference, with no cap.

preference.description: What it takes as its preference: zero for a class that converts or has none.

residual.description: What it takes of the rest, as converted.

seniority.description: 1 is paid first; classes of the same seniority share pari passu.
